items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I got Mr. and Mrs. Valente, Katerina Valente's mother and father and her husband is on this show that I'm on in Kaiserslautern

ctx.x: "South Pacific" the play, a dancer, he knew me and he was there in Kaiserslauternand he had to boost me up to her concerning what they had charged me against that I was not the fault of. The club was prejudiced, seemingly, because they wouldn't keep quiet when I come out to M.C. the show and I was M.C.-ing the show he was with that I had and the show was built around me, you know.

So I'm M.C.-ing the show and when I got on the floor to speak, everybody was noisy, and it's a mixed club now, mixed club, Officer's Club, too. They got white and black in there, you know. I'm standing out on the floor to use the mike to introduce the show, who we got on the show and all, I got Mr. and Mrs. Valente, Katerina Valente's mother and father and her husband is on this show that I'm on in Kaiserslautern, and would you believe that when I went on the floor, intending to introduce the show, I got it all…

they must have been thinking, "What's he standing there for?" They all kept quiet to see what I was going to say. Just like say, "Let's see what he's going to say." Look like they all got together and did that. Quiet. And I just said two words "You're prejudiced. Don't jibe me with nothin', you're prejudiced." That was my thought and I walked off. What did I say that for?
